dt: Program is awaiting a new solicitation and not accepting proposals; NSF 24-529 used March 25 annually
e: Funds pilots of new approaches to STEM graduate training (career preparation, student success) and research on graduate education systems. Limited to two proposals per institution per competition; no citizenship restriction.
n: NSF Innovations in Graduate Education (IGE, NSF 24-529)
unv: No new solicitation posted; next deadline and award sizes unconfirmed for the next cycle. Grants.gov still lists NSF 24-529 with a Mar 25, 2027 close date, but NSF's page says the program is not accepting proposals.
